summary: Elevate your marketing skills with our AI-Powered Social Media Marketing Training Course. Learn to harness AI for effective strategies and engagement.
lede: AI-supported social media marketing uses audience insights and performance data to guide content and campaign decisions. The course is for social media managers, digital marketers, and communications or marketing teams responsible for organizational results; it covers building audience personas, planning and adapting content for Meta, TikTok, and Snapchat, optimizing Meta ad targeting and budgets, and using analytics to report return on investment.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who are responsible for the performance and ROI of their organization's social media efforts. Whether you're working in a corporate setting, an NGO, a startup, or a public institution, this program will enhance your strategic capabilities.
audience: Social media managers and digital marketers
modules: Social Media for Business in the AI Era
Audience Research and Persona Building with AI
AI-Powered Content Strategy and Content Marketing Frameworks
Writing Hooks, Captions, and CTAs Using AI
Visual Design and Video Content Creation with AI Tools
Meta Ads Mastery: Facebook & Instagram Campaign Strategy
AI-Assisted Targeting, Creative Testing, and Budget Optimization
TikTok Marketing for Business: Trends, Scripts, and Growth Systems
Snapchat for Business: Content Formats, Ads Basics, and Community Building
Analytics and Reporting: Measuring ROI Beyond Likes
Ethics, Risk, and Brand Safety in AI Marketing
Building Your AI-Powered Social Media Operating System
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have a basic understanding of social media platforms and digital marketing concepts. Familiarity with AI tools is beneficial but not required.
